name: Reverse lunge
notes: Bodyweight or loaded reverse lunge. Count total steps unless a routine specifies otherwise.

guide.setup: Stand tall with feet hip width, holding dumbbells at the sides if loaded, and brace before stepping.
guide.execution: Step back and lower until both knees are near 90 degrees, then push through the front foot to return to standing.
guide.cues: Stay tall. Keep the front shin close to vertical. Step back to a consistent length.
guide.mistakes: Stepping back too short; front knee collapsing inward; leaning over the front thigh; landing heavily on the rear foot.
